answer.rationale: P99 latency 5x target on write path immediately after release 2h ago during peak settlement traffic points strongly to a regression in the current build. Memory_b1 shows rollback cleared a checkout error spike without customer impact; memory_b6 confirms staged release gating catches regressions fast. The release timing and symptom profile match a deployment-induced issue. Rollback is the fastest path to restore baseline performance during peak write load. We preserve uncertainty by keeping this to a standard experiment scope (monitoring rollback success metrics before confirming), and it directly protects customer writes by removing the likely culprit. If rollback does not resolve latency, we will have capacity for regional failover or circuit breaking in the next intervention window.
